Upon completion, the transfer of autonomous systems from outside NCO territory and corporate resources was initiated. "A Cyborg Manifesto" was a groundbreaking essay written by Donna Haraway in 1984 that explores the intersections of technology, feminism, and identity. The idea that technology has blurred the boundaries between human and machine, challenging the conventional understanding of identity and embodiment. There's more to analyze here, but my attention has been focused on the aspect of technology. I've been putting much thought as of late into the fevor and exponential pace of technological progress that occured during the 21st Century, where the rubicon was crossed. I believe it was the portable celullar device, more clearly defined as the "Smart Phone" that made us cyborgs. This isn't an idea that I would even pretend to be my own, no, it was proposed in theory before the advent of the cybernetics of today by the contemporaries of the smart phone itself. It's curious becuase I believe we will have no one to look back on us, an analyze whether our ideas actually were correct. I purchased a museum long ago, I took a look at one of these devices, it makes sense, anyone who had one had the power to interface with the world around them in ways untold, unheard, unspoken. They used it as a source of external memory, captured moments in time with stunning precision. Yet in many ways chose to manipulate these perfect memories into whatever contrivance best served their own interests. How little we've changed.

Crouching () while running will initiate a slide, you can use this to preserve momentum during movement. This will allow you to slip underneath the pipe. You can also jump () out of a slide for a speedboost.

Enemies that receive enough damage will enter a stun state and flash yellow, you can use your melee () to finish them off with a decapitation. Decapitated enemies will drop Health, Ammo, and Adrenaline.

Many gaps require using multiple walls to complete. While wallrunning, jump () towards the next wall to magnetize to it. Remember, you’re limited to two jumps against walls before your implant needs to recharge.

Some enemies will have additional weakpoints, some will have none. This class of grunt has a jetpack, you can shoot () it to overkill him. Overkilling enemies will also drop rewards, use your weapon class carefully to overkill specific enemy types.
Timing your jumps off different surfaces will allow you to gain height and reach surfaces high above the ground. You can use this to your advantage around corners to make it to the platform above.
To reach the door you just opened, try strafing into a wall run. Jump () towards the wall across the gap in front of you and keep running to the platform. Timing is key.

Walls can be used even when you’re not looking at them. Once you’re magnetized and running, look for the next wall to jump to. For this jump, use the left wall, then run and jump to the wall on the right. You’ll need height and distance to make it to the platform.

While in Bullet Time (), enemies weakpoints will be highlighted, target these in order to kill enemies quickly and preserve scarce ammo. Enemies killed this way will also drop Health, Ammo, and Adrenaline.

While in Bullet Time (), other objects in your environment will highlight, such as cables connecting various pieces of machinery. Other items such as levers, health, ammo, and adrenaline will also highlight.

You can also magnetize to curved walls. Wall run and jump () against these walls to gain height and distance required for long gaps. Remember, you’re limited to two jumps against walls before your implant needs to recharge.

You will need to wall run and wall jump to succeed in the Sprawl. Run against the wall on the left and jump () to magnetize to it. Jump while wallrunning for extra height and distance. You’re limited to two jumps against the wall before your implant needs to recharge. Look for red lights to guide you.

After escaping Klub Null, you’ve been guided into the greater SPRAWL by FATHER. These buildings are from a bygone era, infrastructure built during the boom of industrialization and urbanization. It’s all falling apart now, kept together just enough by the Junta to keep its citizens reliant on their good graces. All the old corporations are gone now, the populace locked to their tiny apartments. Low level workers crammed inside cages with nothing but a sleeping bag.

After subject SEVEN demonstrated mastery over the "Shotgun Jump" AEON Corporation drafted a model of a more complex section of the SPRAWL in order to further develop her skillset. Trainees must hit all the checkpoints in order, and make their way to the finish in the shortest time possible.

FATHER has informed you that unless you do something about the government's ability to wage war, you are fighting a losing battle and it will be only a matter of time before you are overwhelmed. As a result you have been rerouted towards the GOR Complex, a giant manufacturing structure that provides the Junta with its entire military might. Domand Corp was forcibly dismantled 45 years ago, yet its corpse in the form of abandoned factories remain littered through this landscape, old machines and wide open spaces will begin to truly test your mastery over your Icarus implant…

FATHER has tasked you with finding a way out from the greater SPRAWL, and has taken you through the rooftops after locating one of the only viable exit routes. The Junta has been watching your handiwork and is desperately trying to contain you. Higher troop concentrations are expected along your path through the dilapidated rooftops and the structures above. Survive…

It is the year [REDACTED], beyond the Walled City lies the SPRAWL, an urban megapolis choked in ash and smog. Here the seeds of unfettered corporatism, of war as commerce, bare soiled fruit. The vast divide between classes has become an irreparable chasm. Corporate entities play with the power of empires, and governments are helpless at their might. Cultural boundaries dissolve as human minds link through cybernetics. While the human soul, confronted with the toils of this failed existence, retreat into digital realities indistinguishable from our own. And you, self-exiled in penance for your sins, seek a peace that will never come…

One of several class four simulacra environments; originally created to train Junta forces being deployed with advanced movement capabilities. These were repurposed by the AEON Corporation in order to demonstrate the theoretical capabilities of their ICARUS implant, as well as to better train users. Trainees must hit all the checkpoints in order, and make their way to the finish in the shortest time possible.

Operation [REDACTED] saw operative FIVE displaying complete mastery of their first generation ICARUS implant. This environment was modeled after that section of the SPRAWL in order to better train operatives SIX and SEVEN. Operative SIX refused to participate, and operative SEVEN beat operative FIVE's time by several minutes. Operative FIVE then removed his ICARUS, claiming it had been neutered intentionally. Trainees must hit all the checkpoints in order, and make their way to the finish in the shortest time possible.

SIX finally got what he wanted, a fair fight. Turns out it was only fair because of that power suit he was using. Well it’s all a pile of scrap now, that’s what he gets for shooting you out a window. You board the transport, but it seems like FATHER has taken you on a detour, the air here is different, the sound of machines is deafening. You’re entering the Badlands, the industrial power base of the Junta, and you see something in the distance that you haven’t seen since you first became SEVEN…

The GOR Complex was created during the last corporate war under the supervision of AEON Corp, formerly the largest cybernetics conglomerate operating within the SPRAWL. Here they experimented on human subjects and pioneered a whole new chapter in the human exercise of cruelty. It was here that the REAPER program you, SIX, and the others were a part of was developed. The Junta has most likely become aware of what you’re planning to do here. They are going to deploy whatever they can to stop you…

The first of several training facilities built on the outskirts of the GOR Complex. In this trial subjects are expected to eliminate all targets in a respective room in order to unlock the doors and proceed with the trial. Doors will not unlock until every target has been eliminated. Trainees must hit all the checkpoints in order, and make their way to the finish in the shortest time possible.

The network of water processing plants underneath the city is vast, but built on the back of ancient infrastructure predating the formation of the SPRAWL as we know it. It fails, and fails often, forcing the populace to rely on packaged water rations from the Junta. It’s this neglect that has created a technological deadzone within the SPRAWL, one which can be abused. The Junta closely monitors and controls all air traffic, but somewhere down here will be the only viable place where FATHER can hijack some sort of transport.

The original developer of the combat simulation scenarios, [REDACTED], was a troubled but brilliant mind. Fascinated by the technological progress that allowed for fully simulated worlds. He was a historian in his own right. They say when his door was knocked down and he was dragged out from his quarters, he was wearing an antiquated piece of tech. A headset from the early 21st century. A fanatic for early VR games of this period, it explains why this simulation was modeled over one of the first proper combat simulations. As well as the... peculiar enemy type.

These warehouses once were used for humanitarian aid and distribution into The Walled City. As more rebel groups expanded into the quarantine zone, the junta pulled back and abandoned them. Here underground clubs, drug manufacturing and more have grown rampant. All smugglers looking to enter or exit the quarantine zone must pass through here, and grease the right hands along the way. At least they used to…

They know you’re here and they’re sending out the big guns, thankfully that railgun you found in the research lab is really helping you out here with the OHGR class mechs. FATHER has directed you to a transport depot in an effort to get you closer to the GOR Complex. Trash compactors and various other maintenance machinery stand in your way. A familiar hum as well, wonder if those flying drones are paying you a visit…

This endless combat simulation is modeled after OPERATION-FLYTRAP, in which operative THREE suffered a complete mental breakdown and went AWOL. For the first time in the 15 years since OPERATION [REDACTED] near complete deployment of Junta ground resources were mobilized in order to contain THREE. The operative was able to hold their ground for nearly three hours before succumbing to their wounds. They were found holding a paper crane with the message "set us free".

This endless combat simulation is modeled after OPERATION-HONEY in which a complete inflitration of a rebel cell was achieved and this area was designated as a "meet up zone". Junta forces were deployed in mass in order to decimate the rebel cell fully. However, one rebel in particular had been given expirimental AEON Corporation augmentations in order to test their effectiveness. The stand off caused far beyond resonable casualties, depending on who was asked of course.

This environment was created after subject SEVEN deployed a traversal mechanic during an operation in which she propelled herself upward using her MEGATECH Shotgun. It was later discovered that more complex movement could be achieved through the combination of "Shotgun Jumping" and ICARUS implant movement capabilities. Trainees must hit all the checkpoints in order, and make their way to the finish in the shortest time possible.

This is it, the end of the line, you’re making your way towards The Spire, the Junta’s crown jewel. Here is where the Junta is able to monitor all traffic on the net, every CCTV within the Sprawl, catalog every citizen and their actions. It’s the center of their power, their fear, and FATHER intends to destroy it. At least, that’s what he says…

This simulation was created from the repurposed fragments of the broken psyche of subject [REDACTED]. Subject [REDACTED] was exposed to two simulacra class [REDACTED], the imagery the intelligences manifested were burned into the memories of subject [REDACTED]. Reaper program participants were repeated placed in combat scenarios here for a yet to be determined reason.

This simulation was created to study subject [REDACTED] and their combat efficiency against Imperial OPSEC Troopers during their escape from a classified facility. The hope would be that AEON Corporation would be able to mirror this effectiveness in order to better engage against the same class of enemy forces.

Without ever having to enter the structure, you were able to destroy the GOR Complex by overwhelming the cooling and power supply generators right below it. FATHER has hijacked a transport and is flying you as close as he can to the spire. This place is where the elite of this hell live, but their paradise is warped, old brutalist structures dominate the landscape. It’s unnerving here, cold, and foreboding, but nothing compared to what's coming. You are approaching the outskirts of the Dark City, and ever closer to the Spire…

You move down the crater that houses the spire, you realize this served as a panopticon for the elite, they were prisoners as well. If you want access to the Spire however you'll need the proper biometrics to pass their security, FATHER insists he can’t do it, and frankly you don’t care. He’s pointed you in the direction of one of the politicians that helped frame you all those years ago. They took your eyes when they exiled you, and like Hamurabi said…
